items.title: Joseph "One Eyed Babe" Phillips Interview, 1957-03-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Up in Playman Williams territory? [INTERVIEWEE] That's right. Playman Williams place. Okay.

ctx.x: Oh, I played with the Lord in so many towns. All in the country. I played St. James. I played St. John. I played St. Charles Parish. Played music all different places. We were at Dansonville when I was out there.
That's right. Playman Williams place. Okay.

items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Up in Playman Williams territory. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right. Playman Williams, please. Out there.

ctx.x: That's right. Playman Williams, please. Out there.

I talked to Freddie Landry up there about a year ago, the trombone play. You remember him? I remember him. Play trombone and piano? I remember him. I think his brother's name was Al C. You remember the big boy? Yeah. He came down here and worked with the Eureka Band. Remember all those fellas from up there?
